{
  "test_name": "LedgerIssue2234AnalyzerSuppressSourceGeneration",
  "test_code": "using System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class LedgerIssue2234AnalyzerSuppressSourceGeneration\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task AnalyzerReportsDuplicateKeyWhenSourceGenerationIsSuppressed()\n    {\n        const string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace TempProject\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)]\n                public class MyObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int First { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int Second { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync(source);\n        var msgPackDiagnostics = analyzerDiagnostics.Where(static d => d.Id.StartsWith(\"MsgPack\")).ToImmutableArray();\n\n        Assert.True(msgPackDiagnostics.Length > 0, \"The analyzer did not report any MsgPack diagnostics for a type with SuppressSourceGeneration = true.\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task AnalyzerReportsNothingForValidTypeWhenSourceGenerationIsSuppressed()\n    {\n        const string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace TempProject\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)]\n                public class MyObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int First { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public int Second { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync(source);\n        var msgPackDiagnostics = analyzerDiagnostics.Where(static d => d.Id.StartsWith(\"MsgPack\")).ToImmutableArray();\n\n        Assert.Empty(msgPackDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<ImmutableArray<Diagnostic>> GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync(string source)\n    {\n        var parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        var syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions);\n\n        var references = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)\n            .Concat(await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None));\n\n        var compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out var _);\n\n        return await output\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n    }\n}"
}
